Enterprises run on thousands of workflows, yet fragmented tools, siloed systems, and mounting complexity create bottlenecks that slow decisions and frustrate customers.

Bizagi was built on the belief that operational excellence requires process visibility, which is why our platform unifies process design, execution, artificial intelligence, and governance in a single layer across your existing systems.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Resources/G2_badges.png)

## Meet our CEO

## We believe in creating value for our customers

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/customer_meeting.jpg?t=thumbnail3)

##### Rapid ROI

Our Expert Services team bring a proven [implementation methodology](https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/bizagi-spark "Bizagi Spark") along with best practices and architectural guidance to help our customers deliver fast time to value.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/man_at_desk.jpg?t=thumbnail3)

##### AI with impact

Our [AI capabilities](https://www.bizagi.com/en/solutions/artificial-intelligence "Artificial Intelligence - Empower With AI | Bizagi") enable organizations to add AI into end-to-end processes with built-in governance and enterprise-class security without specialist skills.

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/Success.jpg?t=thumbnail3)

##### Product innovation

We're constantly innovating to stay at the forefront of the market and deliver the latest capabilities to our customers.

## Our story

Scroll to move through the years →

1989

Founded in Bogotá by Gustavo Gómez and co-founders, initially delivering consulting and custom software.

2002

Strategic pivot to dedicated BPM software, laying the groundwork for the Bizagi BPM Suite.

2005

European headquarters opens in Buckinghamshire, UK.

2007

Launch of the Bizagi BPM Suite, enabling organizations to design, automate, and manage business processes through an intuitive interface.

2008

Bizagi Modeler launches as a free BPMN tool, rapidly building a global community of users.

2013

North American office opens in Washington DC; Bizagi recognized as a Strong Performer in the Forrester Wave: Digital Process Automation Software.

2016

Bizagi 11 debuts as “The Digital Business Platform,” expanding into low-code app development and digital process automation.

2017

Named a Challenger in Gartner's iBPMS Magic Quadrant and a Strong Performer in Forrester's Low-Code Development Platforms Wave.

2018

Community surpasses 1 million members.

2020

Achieves FedRAMP Authorization, enabling deployments across US public sector and regulated industries.

2022

First cloud-only version of Bizagi launches, completing the shift to cloud-native delivery.

2023

Recognized as a Strong Performer in the Forrester Wave: Digital Process Automation Software.

2024

Introduces AI capabilities to the platform in the form of GenAI Assistant, Ask Ada and AI Agents.

2025

Expands AI capabilities with the addition of AI Workers.

2026

Earns Microsoft Certified Software Designations for Financial Services AI and Manufacturing AI.
